# Copilot instructions

Start with `specs/production-trial.md` and `docs/production-handoff.md`.

When continuing work in this repository:

1. Build the smallest working version of the app that can be deployed for a real production trial.
2. Prefer incremental changes that keep the repository easy to review and hand off.
3. Document every required third-party account, secret, and environment variable as they are introduced.
4. Add or update tests only where the repository has matching test infrastructure.
5. Keep production setup instructions current so a human can create the required accounts and try the app end to end.
